tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "BD2571EB48427D285894B9959ACDD305", "Mayors can adjust Settlement tax rates which impact how much citizens and visitors will pay when doing business.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "AB141D8E44BC1C0FCD678AA126728ED2", "Global tax rates are a set % for all services. Higher level Settlements allow for Mayors to set taxes based on types of services and even specific buildings.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "33F3E9B14AAE2EA72834BE955E5C8A14", "Taxes are a great way to increase funds for your Settlement, but high taxes can stifle commerce. Make sure your tax rate is one your citizens can afford.")
